title: Google Drops Opal: The Multi-Agent Workflow Engine That Changes Everything
description: The automation world is undergoing a seismic shift. Google Opal connects your spreadsheets, internal databases, Slack channels, and customer support desks into collaborative, autonomous multi-agent workflows.

promptSet.title: Google Opal Enterprise Agent Flow Designer
promptSet.prompt: Design a Google Opal multi-agent workflow for an e-commerce refund request. Specify the triage agent, fraud verification agent, database lookup agent, and final customer email generation step.
instructions: Access Google Opal on the Google Cloud developer console.
Connect your workspace data sources (Sheets, BigQuery, Gmail).
Deploy autonomous agents with human-in-the-loop approval thresholds.
promptSet.exampleOutput: Visual workflow schema defining 4 specialized agents collaborating on customer operations.
